remarks: Nestled in the coveted Portal Rock community, this beautifully updated two-bedroom, one-bath rental offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience. This sun-filled, one level unit features features a brand-new kitchen with stainless steel appliances, refinished hardwood floors, crown molding, and recessed lighting throughout. The spacious open-concept living and dining area is ideal for both relaxing and entertaining, with ample space for a dedicated home office. Both generously sized bedrooms are filled with natural light and offer serene views of the beautifully landscaped grounds, creating a peaceful and private atmosphere. Step outside to enjoy your own patio and lush green space, complete with colorful blooms and peach tree all perfect for outdoor dining, gardening, or simply unwinding in nature. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, central air, gas heat, one assigned parking space and visitor parking. Located just a 12-minute walk from the Cos Cob train station, commuting is effortless. Shops, restaurants, parks, Cos Cob Park, the Mianus River trails, and all that Greenwich has to offer are just moments away. Easy living at its best!
